buildCommand: npm --prefix web-pcces/frontend ci && npm --prefix web-pcces/frontend run build && python -c "import shutil,os;s='web-pcces/frontend/dist';d='api/static';[shutil.copy2(os.path.join(s,f),d) for f in os.listdir(s) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(s,f))];[shutil.copytree(os.path.join(s,sub),os.path.join(d,sub),dirs_exist_ok=1) for sub in os.listdir(s) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(s,sub))]"
